summary.tldr: Bill S-17 makes small wording, reference, and naming fixes across federal laws and regulations, and repeals a few provisions that no longer apply.
what_it_does: Corrects grammar, spelling, terminology, punctuation, cross-references, archaic wording, and English-French wording differences in 58 Acts and three related regulations.
Updates the names or designations of some professionals and a tribunal, including changing the Review Tribunal name to the Canada Agricultural Review Tribunal.
Corrects the names of some provincial courts to match court reorganisations in those provinces.
Repeals three provisions from Acts that no longer have any application, including section 12 of the Department of Transport Act.
summary.background: Bill S-17 is the 13th bill in the Miscellaneous Statute Law Amendment Program. It was based on reports from the House of Commons and Senate justice committees.
